scenes.headline: How a browser game fights an army
scenes.sub: Voxel Musou's crowd, clock and combo, read from the code.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pixel! Voxel Musou pits one hero against a voxel army in a browser tab. Here's how.

scenes.label: The trick
scenes.text: The army is a fixed pool of 300 slots. A director keeps about 84 of them on the hero, and recycles the dead.
scenes.say: The trick: the army is a fixed pool of three hundred slots. A director keeps about eighty-four on the hero, and recycles the dead.

steps.say: Every soldier is a slot in a pool, sized once at boot. Nothing is allocated after that.
Every twenty frames, a director counts the fighters. Under eighty-four, the nearest waiting block marches in.
A knocked-out soldier frees his slot three and a half seconds later, and returns as a reinforcement.

steps.note: ?enemies sets how many wait at the edge, not the size of the fight
steps.say: So the enemies setting only changes how many wait at the edge. The fight stays eighty-four strong.

items.say: Each frame banks its elapsed time, capped at a tenth of a second.
It spends that time in sixtieth-of-a-second steps, at most four per frame.
If it's still behind, it drops the rest, so a slow machine plays in slow motion.
Then it draws. Two seeded random streams make fights repeatable.

scenes.title: Why the combo keeps its beat
scenes.say: Each hit freezes the hero for a few frames, which would drag the combo off its beat. One rule fixes that.

parts.note: frames the current move has played
parts.say: Move T: frames the move has played.

parts.note: frames the hero spent frozen by hitstop
parts.say: Stop: frames spent frozen by hitstop.

parts.note: 8: up to eight frozen frames count as played
parts.say: Absorb is eight: up to eight frozen frames count as played.

parts.note: the frame from which the next strike may start
parts.say: So the next strike starts on time, even in a ring of twenty.

scenes.title: Frames between the six strikes
scenes.say: From the move table: strikes twenty-five, twenty-six, twenty-four and twenty-six frames apart, then a late thirty-five.

scenes.text: The feel is data: a pool, a clock and a frame table you can check by hand.

recap: The army is a 300-slot pool; about 84 fight
A 60 Hz step that slows instead of spiralling
Hitstop is absorbed into the combo's beat
scenes.say: To recap: a recycled pool, a clock that slows instead of spiralling, and hitstop folded into the beat.
